rules_applied: research-use and redistribution are independent dimensions
unresolved or not-permitted research use never enters the training manifest
each verified decision cites an archived official document with SHA-256
no source is excluded to hit a target image count

sources.evidence_excerpt: "licenseName": "Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International (CC BY-NC 4.0)"; description: "The purpose of this dataset is to gain a better understanding of object detection and its applications in agriculture."
sources.research_use_conditions: NonCommercial only, with attribution. This project is academic, non-commercial research; the NonCommercial condition is therefore satisfied for local training, but it must be re-checked if the work is ever used commercially.
sources.redistribution_conditions: CC BY-NC 4.0 permits sharing for NonCommercial purposes with attribution and a link to the licence; project policy is to withhold the images anyway so downstream users are not bound by NC
sources.derived_release_conditions: NonCommercial + attribution carry over to derivatives
sources.checkpoint_release_conditions: A published checkpoint is a derivative of the images. Whether releasing it is a NonCommercial act depends on how downstream users deploy it; this is not decidable from the licence text alone.
sources.open_issues: Checkpoint-release question is genuinely unresolved, not "no". Research training is permitted; publishing weights trained on this dataset needs an explicit decision before Stage 6 release.
sources.decision_reason: CC BY-NC 4.0 allows non-commercial research use with attribution. The project is academic and non-commercial, so training inclusion is allowed; checkpoint release is recorded as unresolved and kept separate.
